Our work spans coding, tool use, computer use, multi-agent coordination, long-horizon execution, factuality, instruction following, calibrated reasoning, and taste. jobs.description_text: About ZURU Tech ZURU is a reimagination company, building next-generation products and brands across toys, consumer goods, pet science and construction. ZURU Tech is leading the next building revolution. Construction is one of the world’s biggest industries, but it’s one of the last to be transformed by technology. Buildings are still designed in disconnected tools, engineered by hand and pieced together on site. We’re changing that. We’ve spent the past decade rebuilding the process from the ground up, starting with the world’s first BIM software connected directly to fully automated production. It’s software for everyone. Our multidisciplinary engineers combine architecture, structural and civil engineering with software development, and they build that know-how into the platform, so you don’t need to be an expert to design a building. We use AI across our team, with dedicated AI & ML specialists and engineers who use AI agents every day to prototype and ship faster. In the platform, AI handles non-creative decisions and checks designs, that way, users can focus on the design itself. When a design is ready, it goes straight to our automated factory. There, machines and robots we build ourselves make the components with precision, and the components are shipped for fast assembly on site. The ACLU seeks a Graduate Intern for the Trans Justice Campaign within the National Political Advocacy Department of the ACLU’s National office in New York. This internship can be full-time or part-time and is Hybrid.

Qualifying applicants must currently be matriculated graduate students or an equivalent combination of education and/or experience and must be based in the U.S. for the entire duration of the internship.

The Team:

The National Political Advocacy Department (NPAD) works to strengthen the efforts of the ACLU at the federal, state, and local levels of government.
